gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-mono: Retro and crowded, with letters jammed nearly shut. Noto Sans Mono opens every curve wide beside it, so the sturdy, tall sans lowercase gives those tight headings some room to breathe.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham reads bold and open, its tall lowercase leaving wide gaps. Styro is best at tight, commanding retro display; the sans-serif body is best at staying open and clear.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Retro, pressed-tight Styro headings sit above a body whose curve tails hold well back from each letter. The strongest quality is how snug meets open.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Noto Sans Old Italic keeps its capitals and lowercase nearly level. Styro does crowded, retro display best, while the plain sans body does open, unhurried curves best.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Crowded, retro and commanding up top. Below it, Noto Sans Old Persian lets open counters breathe, so a long passage in its lofty, tall lowercase would read light and unhurried.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Styro is retro and commanding, its letters pressed almost shut. The strongest quality is the sharp turn to Noto Sans Old Turkic, whose chunky, tall sans lowercase keeps every curve open and clear.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Approachable first, thanks to Noto Sans Oriya and its generous curves. Over a longer passage the sans lowercase, nearly as tall as its capitals, would feel steady against Styro's crowded, retro headings.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-osage: Retro and tight, with commanding display letters. Noto Sans Osage then fills the line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves, so the sans-serif body loosens everything Styro pulls shut.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Styro packs its sizable lowercase so tightly that the e and c nearly close up. Noto Sans Osmanya, a plain sans, answers with easy s turns and oversized lowercase.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Styro crowds its retro, commanding letters until the e and c barely open. And Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau feels like a window thrown open beside it, its plain sans curves roomy and its lowercase nearly capital height.
